mingana-1572a.arabic_base: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ۞وتري الشمس اذا طلعت تزور عن كهفهم ذات اليمين واذا غربت تقرضهم ذات الشمال وهم في فجوه منه ذلك من ءايت الله من يهد الله فهو المهتد ومن يضلل فلن تجد لهۥ ولي ا مرشد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And thou mightest have seen the sun when it rose move away from their cave to the right, and when it set go past them on the left, and they were in the cleft thereof. That was (one) of the portents of Allah. He whom Allah guideth, he indeed is led aright, and he whom He sendeth astray, for him thou wilt not find a guiding friend

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وتحسبهم ايقاظ ا وهم رقود ونقلبهم ذات اليمين وذات الشمال وكلبهم بسط ذراعيه بالوصيد لو اطلعت عليهم لوليت منهم فرار ا ولمليت منهم رعب ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And thou wouldst have deemed them waking though they were asleep, and We caused them to turn over to the right and the left, and their dog stretching out his paws on the threshold. If thou hadst observed them closely thou hadst assuredly turned away from them in flight, and hadst been filled with awe of them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وكذلك بعثنهم ليتساءلوا بينهم قال قايل منهم كم لبثتم قالوا لبثنا يوما او بعض يوم قالوا ربكم اعلم بما لبثتم فابعثوا احدكم بورقكم هذهۦ الي المدينه فلينظر ايها ازكي طعام ا فلياتكم برزق منه وليتلطف ولا يشعرن بكم احدا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And in like manner We awakened them that they might question one another. A speaker from among them said: How long have ye tarried? They said: We have tarried a day or some part of a day, (Others) said: Your Lord best knoweth what ye have tarried. Now send one of you with this your silver coin unto the city, and let him see what food is purest there and bring you a supply thereof. Let him be courteous and let no man know of you

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: انهم ان يظهروا عليكم يرجموكم او يعيدوكم في ملتهم ولن تفلحوا اذا ابد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: For they, if they should come to know of you, will stone you or turn you back to their religion; then ye will never prosper

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وكذلك اعثرنا عليهم ليعلموا ان وعد الله حق وان الساعه لا ريب فيها اذ يتنزعون بينهم امرهم فقالوا ابنوا عليهم بنين ا ربهم اعلم بهم قال الذين غلبوا علي امرهم لنتخذن عليهم مسجد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And in like manner We disclosed them (to the people of the city) that they might know that the promise of Allah is true, and that, as for the Hour, there is no doubt concerning it. When (the people of the city) disputed of their case among themselves, they said: Build over them a building; their Lord knoweth best concerning them. Those who won their point said: We verily shall build a place of worship over them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: سيقولون ثلثه رابعهم كلبهم ويقولون خمسه سادسهم كلبهم رجما بالغيب ويقولون سبعه وثامنهم كلبهم قل ربي اعلم بعدتهم ما يعلمهم الا قليل فلا تمار فيهم الا مراء ظهر ا ولا تستفت فيهم منهم احد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: (Some) will say: They were three, their dog the fourth, and (some) say: Five, their dog the sixth, guessing at random; and (some) say: Seven, and their dog the eighth. Say (O Muhammad): My Lord is Best Aware of their number. None knoweth them save a few. So contend not concerning them except with an outward contending, and ask not any of them to pronounce concerning them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولا تقولن لشايء اني فاعل ذلك غدا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And say not of anything: Lo! I shall do that tomorrow

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الا ان يشاء الله واذكر ربك اذا نسيت وقل عسي ان يهدين ربي لاقرب من هذا رشد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Except if Allah will. And remember thy Lord when thou forgettest, and say: It may be that my Lord guideth me unto a nearer way of truth than this

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولبثوا في كهفهم ثلث مايه سنين وازدادوا تسع ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And (it is said) they tarried in their Cave three hundred years and add nine

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قل الله اعلم بما لبثوا لهۥ غيب السموت والارض ابصر بهۦ واسمع ما لهم من دونهۦ من ولي ولا يشرك في حكمهۦ احد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Say: Allah is Best Aware how long they tarried. His is the Invisible of the heavens and the earth. How clear of sight is He and keen of hearing! They have no protecting friend beside Him, and He maketh none to share in His government

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واتل ما اوحي اليك من كتاب ربك لا مبدل لكلمتهۦ ولن تجد من دونهۦ ملتحد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And recite that which hath been revealed unto thee of the Scripture of thy Lord. There is none who can change His words, and thou wilt find no refuge beside Him

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واصبر نفسك مع الذين يدعون ربهم بالغدوه والعشي يريدون وجههۥ ولا تعد عيناك عنهم تريد زينه الحيوه الدنيا ولا تطع من اغفلنا قلبهۥ عن ذكرنا واتبع هويه وكان امرهۥ فرط ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Restrain thyself along with those who cry unto their Lord at morn and evening, seeking His Countenance; and let not thine eyes overlook them, desiring the pomp of the life of the world; and obey not him whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance, who followeth his own lust and whose case hath been abandoned

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وقل الحق من ربكم فمن شاء فليومن ومن شاء فليكفر انا اعتدنا للظلمين نارا احاط بهم سرادقها وان يستغيثوا يغاثوا بماء كالمهل يشوي الوجوه بيس الشراب وساءت مرتفقا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Say: (It is) the truth from the Lord of you (all). Then whosoever will, let him believe, and whosoever will, let him disbelieve. Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers Fire. Its tent encloseth them. If they ask for showers, they will be showered with water like to molten lead which burneth the faces. Calamitous the drink and ill the resting-place

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت انا لا نضيع اجر من احسن عملا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! as for those who believe and do good works - Lo! We suffer not the reward of one whose work is goodly to be lost

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Diplomatic rasm of extant leaves (after Fedeli / Birmingham; undotted Hijazi)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اوليك لهم جنت عدن تجري من تحتهم الانهر يحلون فيها من اساور من ذهب ويلبسون ثيابا خضر ا من سندس واستبرق متكين فيها علي الارايك نعم الثواب وحسنت مرتفق ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: As for such, theirs will be Gardens of Eden, wherein rivers flow beneath them; therein they will be given armlets of gold and will wear green robes of finest silk and gold embroidery, reclining upon throne therein. Blest the reward, and fair the resting-place

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Surah Maryam closing verses on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان دعوا للرحمن ولد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: That ye ascribe unto the Beneficent a son

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Surah Maryam closing verses on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما ينبغي للرحمن ان يتخذ ولدا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: When it is not meet for (the Majesty of) the Beneficent that He should choose a son

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Surah Maryam closing verses on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان كل من في السموت والارض الا ءاتي الرحمن عبد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Surah Maryam closing verses on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لقد احصيهم وعدهم عد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Verily He knoweth them and numbereth them with (right) numbering

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Surah Maryam closing verses on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وكلهم ءاتيه يوم القيمه فردا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And each one of them will come unto Him on the Day of Resurrection, alone

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Surah Maryam closing verses on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت سيجعل لهم الرحمن ود ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Surah Maryam closing verses on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فانما يسرنه بلسانك لتبشر به المتقين وتنذر بهۦ قوم ا لد ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And We make (this Scripture) easy in thy tongue, (O Muhammad) only that thou mayst bear good tidings therewith unto those who ward off (evil), and warn therewith the froward folk

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Surah Maryam closing verses on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وكم اهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هل تحس منهم من احد او تسمع لهم ركزا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Canst thou (Muhammad) see a single man of them, or hear from them the slightest sound

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: طه
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Ta. Ha

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ما انزلنا عليك القرءان لتشقي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: We have not revealed unto thee (Muhammad) this Qur'an that thou shouldst be distressed

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الا تذكره لمن يخشي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: But as a reminder unto him who feareth

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: تنزيل ا ممن خلق الارض والسموت العلي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: A revelation from Him Who created the earth and the high heavens

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الرحمن علي العرش استوي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: The Beneficent One, Who is established on the Throne

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لهۥ ما في السموت وما في الارض وما بينهما وما تحت الثري
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them, and whatsoever is beneath the sod

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وان تجهر بالقول فانهۥ يعلم السر واخفي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الله لا اله الا هو له الاسماء الحسني
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. His are the most beautiful names

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وهل اتيك حديث موسي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Hath there come unto thee the story of Moses

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اذ رءا نار ا فقال لاهله امكثوا اني ءانست نار ا لعلي ءاتيكم منها بقبس او اجد علي النار هد ي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: When he saw a fire and said unto his folk: Lo! Wait! I see a fire afar off. Peradventure I may bring you a brand therefrom or may find guidance at the fire

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فلما اتيها نودي يموسي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when he reached it, he was called by name: O Moses

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اني انا ربك فاخلع نعليك انك بالواد المقدس طو ي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! I, even I, am thy Lord, So take off thy shoes, for lo! thou art in the holy valley of Tuwa

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وانا اخترتك فاستمع لما يوحي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And I have chosen thee, so hearken unto that which is inspired

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: انني انا الله لا اله الا انا فاعبدني واقم الصلوه لذكري
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! I, even I, am Allah, There is no Allah save Me. So serve Me and establish worship for My remembrance

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان الساعه ءاتيه اكاد اخفيها لتجزي كل نفس بما تسعي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! the Hour is surely coming. But I will to keep it hidden, that every soul may be rewarded for that which it striveth (to achieve)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فلا يصدنك عنها من لا يومن بها واتبع هويه فتردي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما تلك بيمينك يموسي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And what is that in thy right hand, O Moses

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قال هي عصاي اتوكوا عليها واهش بها علي غنمي ولي فيها مارب اخري
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He said: This is my staff whereon I lean, and wherewith I bear down branches for my sheep, and wherein I find other uses

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قال القها يموسي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He said: Cast it down, O Moses

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فالقيها فاذا هي حيه تسعي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: So he cast it down, and lo! it was a serpent, gliding

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قال خذها ولا تخف سنعيدها سيرتها الاولي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He said: Grasp it and fear not. We shall return it to its former state

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان اقذفيه في التابوت فاقذفيه في اليم فليلقه اليم بالساحل ياخذه عدو لي وعدو لهۥ والقيت عليك محبه مني ولتصنع علي عيني
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Saying: Throw him into the ark, and throw it into the river, then the river shall throw it on to the bank, and there an enemy to Me and an enemy to him shall take him. And I endued thee with love from Me that thou mightest be trained according to My will

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening of Surah Ta-Ha on 1572a
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اذ تمشي اختك فتقول هل ادلكم علي من يكفلهۥ فرجعنك الي امك كي تقر عينها ولا تحزن وقتلت نفس ا فنجينك من الغم وفتنك فتون ا فلبثت سنين في اهل مدين ثم جيت علي قدر يموسي
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الم
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Alif. Lam. Mim

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ذلك الكتب لا ريب فيه هد ي للمتقين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: This is the Scripture whereof there is no doubt, a guidance unto those who ward off (evil)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الذين يومنون بالغيب ويقيمون الصلوه ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Who believe in the Unseen, and establish worship, and spend of that We have bestowed upon them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: والذين يومنون بما انزل اليك وما انزل من قبلك وبالاخره هم يوقنون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اوليك علي هد ي من ربهم واوليك هم المفلحون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان الذين كفروا سواء عليهم ءانذرتهم ام لم تنذرهم لا يومنون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: As for the Disbelievers, Whether thou warn them or thou warn them not it is all one for them; they believe not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ختم الله علي قلوبهم وعلي سمعهم وعلي ابصرهم غشوه ولهم عذاب عظيم‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Allah hath sealed their hearing and their hearts, and on their eyes there is a covering. Theirs will be an awful doom

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ومن الناس من يقول ءامنا بالله وباليوم الاخر وما هم بمومنين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And of mankind are some who say: We believe in Allah and the Last Day, when they believe not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يخدعون الله والذين ءامنوا وما يخدعون الا انفسهم وما يشعرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They think to beguile Allah and those who believe, and they beguile none save themselves; but they perceive not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: في قلوبهم مرض فزادهم الله مرض ا ولهم عذاب اليم بما كانوا يكذبون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: In their hearts is a disease, and Allah increaseth their disease. A painful doom is theirs because they lie

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذا قيل لهم لا تفسدوا في الارض قالوا انما نحن مصلحون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when it is said unto them: Make not mischief in the earth, they say: We are peacemakers only

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الا انهم هم المفسدون ولكن لا يشعرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Are not they indeed the mischief-makers? But they perceive not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذا قيل لهم ءامنوا كما ءامن الناس قالوا انومن كما ءامن السفهاء الا انهم هم السفهاء ولكن لا يعلمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when it is said unto them: believe as the people believe, they say: shall we believe as the foolish believe? are not they indeed the foolish? But they know not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذا لقوا الذين ءامنوا قالوا ءامنا واذا خلوا الي شيطينهم قالوا انا معكم انما نحن مستهزءون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when they fall in with those who believe, they say: We believe; but when they go apart to their devils they declare: Lo! we are with you; verily we did but mock

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الله يستهزي بهم ويمدهم في طغينهم يعمهون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Allah (Himself) doth mock them, leaving them to wander blindly on in their contumacy

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اوليك الذين اشتروا الضلله بالهدي فما ربحت تجرتهم وما كانوا مهتدين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, so their commerce doth not prosper, neither are they guided

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: مثلهم كمثل الذي استوقد نار ا فلما اضاءت ما حولهۥ ذهب الله بنورهم وتركهم في ظلمت لا يبصرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Their likeness is as the likeness of one who kindleth fire, and when it sheddeth its light around him Allah taketh away their light and leaveth them in darkness, where they cannot see

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: صم بكم عمي فهم لا يرجعون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Deaf, dumb and blind; and they return not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: او كصيب من السماء فيه ظلمت ورعد وبرق يجعلون اصبعهم في ءاذانهم من الصوعق حذر الموت والله محيط بالكفرين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Or like a rainstorm from the sky, wherein is darkness, thunder and the flash of lightning. They thrust their fingers in their ears by reason of the thunder-claps, for fear of death, Allah encompasseth the disbelievers (in His guidance, His omniscience and His omnipotence)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Opening al-Baqara on Parisino leaves (standard rasm for extant span)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يكاد البرق يخطف ابصرهم كلما اضاء لهم مشوا فيه واذا اظلم عليهم قاموا ولو شاء الله لذهب بسمعهم وابصرهم ان الله علي كل شيء قدير‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: The lightning almost snatcheth away their sight from them. As often as it flasheth forth for them they walk therein, and when it darkeneth against them they stand still. If Allah willed, He could destroy their hearing and their sight. Lo! Allah is able to do all things

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فاستجبنا لهۥ ووهبنا لهۥ يحيي واصلحنا لهۥ زوجهۥ انهم كانوا يسرعون في الخيرت ويدعوننا رغب ا ورهب ا وكانوا لنا خشعين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Then We heard his prayer, and bestowed upon him John, and adjusted his wife (to bear a child) for him. Lo! they used to vie one with the other in good deeds, and they cried unto Us in longing and in fear, and were submissive unto Us

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: والتي احصنت فرجها فنفخنا فيها من روحنا وجعلنها وابنها ءايه للعلمين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And she who was chaste, therefor We breathed into her (something) of Our Spirit and made her and her son a token for (all) peoples

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان هذهۦ امتكم امه وحده وانا ربكم فاعبدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وتقطعوا امرهم بينهم كل الينا رجعون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And they have broken their religion (into fragments) among them, (yet) all are returning unto Us

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فمن يعمل من الصلحت وهو مومن فلا كفران لسعيهۦ وانا لهۥ كتبون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وحرم علي قريه اهلكنها انهم لا يرجعون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And there is a ban upon any community which We have destroyed: that they shall not return

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: حتي اذا فتحت ياجوج وماجوج وهم من كل حدب ينسلون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Until, when Gog and Magog are let loose, and they hasten out of every mound

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واقترب الوعد الحق فاذا هي شخصه ابصر الذين كفروا يويلنا قد كنا في غفله من هذا بل كنا ظلمين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And the True Promise draweth nigh; then behold them, staring wide (in terror), the eyes of those who disbelieve! (They say): Alas for us! We (lived) in forgetfulness of this. Ah, but we were wrong-doers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: انكم وما تعبدون من دون الله حصب جهنم انتم لها وردون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! ye (idolaters) and that which ye worship beside Allah are fuel of hell. Thereunto ye will come

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لو كان هولاء ءالهه ما وردوها وكل فيها خلدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: If these had been gods they would not have come thither, but all will abide therein

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لهم فيها زفير وهم فيها لا يسمعون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Therein wailing is their portion, and therein they hear not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان الذين سبقت لهم منا الحسني اوليك عنها مبعدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! those unto whom kindness hath gone forth before from Us, they will be far removed from thence

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لا يسمعون حسيسها وهم في ما اشتهت انفسهم خلدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They will not hear the slightest sound thereof, while they abide in that which their souls desire

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لا يحزنهم الفزع الاكبر وتتلقيهم المليكه هذا يومكم الذي كنتم توعدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: The Supreme Horror will not grieve them, and the angels will welcome them, (saying): This is your Day which ye were promised

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يوم نطوي السماء كطي السجل للكتب كما بدانا اول خلق نعيدهۥ وعدا علينا انا كنا فعلين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولقد كتبنا في الزبور من بعد الذكر ان الارض يرثها عبادي الصلحون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And verily we have written in the Scripture, after the Reminder: My righteous slaves will inherit the earth

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان في هذا لبلغ ا لقوم عبدين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما ارسلنك الا رحمه للعلمين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: We sent thee not save as a mercy for the peoples

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قل انما يوحي الي انما الهكم اله وحد فهل انتم مسلمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Say: It is only inspired in me that your Allah is One Allah. Will ye then surrender (unto Him)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فان تولوا فقل ءاذنتكم علي سواء وان ادري اقريب ام بعيد ما توعدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: But if they are averse, then say: I have warned you all alike, although I know not whether nigh or far is that which ye are promised

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: انهۥ يعلم الجهر من القول ويعلم ما تكتمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! He knoweth that which is said openly, and that which ye conceal

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وان ادري لعلهۥ فتنه لكم ومتع الي حين‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And I know not but that this may be a trial for you, and enjoyment for a while

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قل رب احكم بالحق وربنا الرحمن المستعان علي ما تصفون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He saith: My Lord! Judge Thou with truth. Our Lord is the Beneficent, Whose help is to be implored against that which ye ascribe (unto Him)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يايها النبي اتق الله ولا تطع الكفرين والمنفقين ان الله كان عليما حكيم ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: O Prophet! Keep thy duty to Allah and obey not the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واتبع ما يوحي اليك من ربك ان الله كان بما تعملون خبير ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And follow that which is inspired in thee from thy Lord. Lo! Allah is Aware of what ye do

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وتوكل علي الله وكفي بالله وكيل ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And put thy trust in Allah, for Allah is sufficient as Trustee

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ما جعل الله لرجل من قلبين في جوفهۦ وما جعل ازوجكم الي تظهرون منهن امهتكم وما جعل ادعياءكم ابناءكم ذلكم قولكم بافوهكم والله يقول الحق وهو يهدي السبيل
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Allah hath not assigned unto any man two hearts within his body, nor hath He made your wives whom ye declare (to be your mothers) your mothers, nor hath He made those whom ye claim (to be your sons) your sons. This is but a saying of your mouths. But Allah saith the truth and He showeth the way

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ادعوهم لابايهم هو اقسط عند الله فان لم تعلموا ءاباءهم فاخونكم في الدين وموليكم وليس عليكم جناح فيما اخطاتم بهۦ ولكن ما تعمدت قلوبكم وكان الله غفور ا رحيما
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Proclaim their real parentage. That will be more equitable in the sight of Allah. And if ye know not their fathers, then (they are) your brethren in the faith, and your clients. And there is no sin for you in the mistakes that ye make unintentionally, but what your hearts purpose (that will be a sin for you). Allah is ever Forgiving, Merciful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: النبي اولي بالمومنين من انفسهم وازوجهۥ امهتهم واولوا الارحام بعضهم اولي ببعض في كتب الله من المومنين والمهجرين الا ان تفعلوا الي اوليايكم معروف ا كان ذلك في الكتب مسطور ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: The Prophet is closer to the believers than their selves, and his wives are (as) their mothers. And the owners of kinship are closer one to another in the ordinance of Allah than (other) believers and the fugitives (who fled from Mecca), except that ye should do kindness to your friends. This is written in the Book (of nature)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذ اخذنا من النبين ميثقهم ومنك ومن نوح وابرهيم وموسي وعيسي ابن مريم واخذنا منهم ميثقا غليظ ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when We exacted a covenant from the prophets, and from thee (O Muhammad) and from Noah and Abraham and Moses and Jesus son of Mary. We took from them a solemn covenant

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ليسل الصدقين عن صدقهم واعد للكفرين عذابا اليم ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: That He may ask the loyal of their loyalty. And He hath prepared a painful doom for the unfaithful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذكروا نعمه الله عليكم اذ جاءتكم جنود فارسلنا عليهم ريح ا وجنود ا لم تروها وكان الله بما تعملون بصيرا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: O ye who believe! Remember Allah's favour unto you when there came against you hosts, and We sent against them a great wind and hosts ye could not see. And Allah is ever Seer of what ye do

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on published BL folio
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اذ جاءوكم من فوقكم ومن اسفل منكم واذ زاغت الابصر وبلغت القلوب الحناجر وتظنون بالله الظنونا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: When they came upon you from above you and from below you, and when eyes grew wild and hearts reached to the throats, and ye were imagining vain thoughts concerning Allah

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الر كتب احكمت ءايتهۥ ثم فصلت من لدن حكيم خبير
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Alif. Lam. Ra. (This is) a Scripture the revelations whereof are perfected and then expounded. (It cometh) from One Wise, Informed

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الا تعبدوا الا الله انني لكم منه نذير وبشير‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: (Saying): Serve none but Allah. Lo! I am unto you from Him a warner and a bringer of good tidings

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وان استغفروا ربكم ثم توبوا اليه يمتعكم متعا حسنا الي اجل مسم ي ويوت كل ذي فضل فضلهۥ وان تولوا فاني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم كبير
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And (bidding you): Ask pardon of your Lord and turn to Him repentant. He will cause you to enjoy a fair estate until a time appointed. He giveth His bounty unto every bountiful one. But if ye turn away, lo! (then) I fear for you the retribution of an awful Day

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الي الله مرجعكم وهو علي كل شيء قدير
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Unto Allah is your return, and He is Able to do all things

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الا انهم يثنون صدورهم ليستخفوا منه الا حين يستغشون ثيابهم يعلم ما يسرون وما يعلنون انهۥ عليم بذات الصدور
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! now they fold up their breasts that they may hide (their thoughts) from Him. At the very moment when they cover themselves with their clothing, Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden and that which they proclaim. Lo! He is Aware of what is in the breasts (of men)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ۞وما من دابه في الارض الا علي الله رزقها ويعلم مستقرها ومستودعها كل في كتب مبين‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And there is not a beast in the earth but the sustenance thereof dependeth on Allah. He knoweth its habitation and its repository. All is in a clear Record

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وهو الذي خلق السموت والارض في سته ايام وكان عرشهۥ علي الماء ليبلوكم ايكم احسن عمل ا ولين قلت انكم مبعوثون من بعد الموت ليقولن الذين كفروا ان هذا الا سحر مبين‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And He it is Who created the heavens and the earth in six Days - and His Throne was upon the water - that He might try you, which of you is best in conduct. Yet if thou (O Muhammad) sayest: Lo! ye will be raised again after death! those who disbelieve will surely say: This is naught but mere magic

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولين اخرنا عنهم العذاب الي امه معدوده ليقولن ما يحبسهۥ الا يوم ياتيهم ليس مصروفا عنهم وحاق بهم ما كانوا بهۦ يستهزءون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And if We delay for them the doom until a reckoned time, they will surely say: What withholdeth it? Verily on the day when it cometh unto them, it cannot be averted from them, and that which they derided will surround them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولين اذقنا الانسن منا رحمه ثم نزعنها منه انهۥ ليوس كفور‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And if we cause man to taste some mercy from Us and afterward withdraw it from him, lo! he is despairing, thankless

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولين اذقنه نعماء بعد ضراء مسته ليقولن ذهب السيات عني انهۥ لفرح فخور
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And if We cause him to taste grace after some misfortune that had befallen him, he saith: The ills have gone from me. Lo! he is exultant, boastful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الا الذين صبروا وعملوا الصلحت اوليك لهم مغفره واجر كبير‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Save those who persevere and do good works. Theirs will be forgiveness and a great reward

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فلعلك تارك بعض ما يوحي اليك وضايق بهۦ صدرك ان يقولوا لولا انزل عليه كنز او جاء معهۥ ملك انما انت نذير والله علي كل شيء وكيل
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: A likely thing, that thou wouldst forsake aught of that which hath been revealed unto thee, and that thy breast should be straitened for it, because they say: Why hath not a treasure been sent down for him, or an angel come with him? Thou art but a warner, and Allah is in charge of all things

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ام يقولون افتريه قل فاتوا بعشر سور مثلهۦ مفتريت وادعوا من استطعتم من دون الله ان كنتم صدقين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Or they say: He hath invented it. Say: Then bring ten surahs, the like thereof, invented, and call on everyone ye can beside Allah, if ye are truthful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فالم يستجيبوا لكم فاعلموا انما انزل بعلم الله وان لا اله الا هو فهل انتم مسلمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And if they answer not your prayer, then know that it is revealed only in the knowledge of Allah; and that there is no Allah save Him. Will ye then be (of) those who surrender

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: من كان يريد الحيوه الدنيا وزينتها نوف اليهم اعملهم فيها وهم فيها لا يبخسون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Whoso desireth the life of the world and its pomp, We shall repay them their deeds herein, and therein they will not be wronged

initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يايها الذين ءامنوا اوفوا بالعقود احلت لكم بهيمه الانعم الا ما يتلي عليكم غير محلي الصيد وانتم حرم ان الله يحكم ما يريد
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: O ye who believe! Fulfil your indentures. The beast of cattle is made lawful unto you (for food) except that which is announced unto you (herein), game being unlawful when ye are on the pilgrimage. Lo! Allah ordaineth that which pleaseth Him

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يايها الذين ءامنوا لا تحلوا شعير الله ولا الشهر الحرام ولا الهدي ولا القليد ولا ءامين البيت الحرام يبتغون فضل ا من ربهم ورضون ا واذا حللتم فاصطادوا ولا يجرمنكم شنان قوم ان صدوكم عن المسجد الحرام ان تعتدوا وتعاونوا علي البر والتقوي ولا تعاونوا علي الاثم والعدون واتقوا الله ان الله شديد العقاب
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: O ye who believe! Profane not Allah's monuments nor the Sacred Month nor the offerings nor the garlands, nor those repairing to the Sacred House, seeking the grace and pleasure of their Lord. But when ye have left the sacred territory, then go hunting (if ye will). And let not your hatred of a folk who (once) stopped your going to the inviolable place of worship seduce you to transgress; but help ye one another unto righteousness and pious duty. Help not one another unto sin and transgression, but keep your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is severe in punishment

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: حرمت عليكم الميته والدم ولحم الخنزير وما اهل لغير الله بهۦ والمنخنقه والموقوذه والمترديه والنطيحه وما اكل السبع الا ما ذكيتم وما ذبح علي النصب وان تستقسموا بالازلم ذلكم فسق اليوم ييس الذين كفروا من دينكم فلا تخشوهم واخشون اليوم اكملت لكم دينكم واتممت عليكم نعمتي ورضيت لكم الاسلم دين ا فمن اضطر في مخمصه غير متجانف لاثم فان الله غفور رحيم‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Forbidden unto you (for food) are carrion and blood and swineflesh, and that which hath been dedicated unto any other than Allah, and the strangled, and the dead through beating, and the dead through falling from a height, and that which hath been killed by (the goring of) horns, and the devoured of wild beasts, saving that which ye make lawful (by the death-stroke), and that which hath been immolated unto idols. And (forbidden is it) that ye swear by the divining arrows. This is an abomination. This day are those who disbelieve in despair of (ever harming) your religion; so fear them not, fear Me! This day have I perfected your religion for you and completed My favour unto you, and have chosen for you as religion al-Islam. Whoso is forced by hunger, not by will, to sin: (for him) lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يسلونك ماذا احل لهم قل احل لكم الطيبت وما علمتم من الجوارح مكلبين تعلمونهن مما علمكم الله فكلوا مما امسكن عليكم واذكروا اسم الله عليه واتقوا الله ان الله سريع الحساب
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They ask thee (O Muhammad) what is made lawful for them. Say: (all) good things are made lawful for you. And those beasts and birds of prey which ye have trained as hounds are trained, ye teach them that which Allah taught you; so eat of that which they catch for you and mention Allah's name upon it, and observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is swift to take account

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اليوم احل لكم الطيبت وطعام الذين اوتوا الكتب حل لكم وطعامكم حل لهم والمحصنت من المومنت والمحصنت من الذين اوتوا الكتب من قبلكم اذا ءاتيتموهن اجورهن محصنين غير مسفحين ولا متخذي اخدان ومن يكفر بالايمن فقد حبط عملهۥ وهو في الاخره من الخسرين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: This day are (all) good things made lawful for you. The food of those who have received the Scripture is lawful for you, and your food is lawful for them. And so are the virtuous women of the believers and the virtuous women of those who received the Scripture before you (lawful for you) when ye give them their marriage portions and live with them in honour, not in fornication, nor taking them as secret concubines. Whoso denieth the faith, his work is vain and he will be among the losers in the Hereafter

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يايها الذين ءامنوا اذا قمتم الي الصلوه فاغسلوا وجوهكم وايديكم الي المرافق وامسحوا برءوسكم وارجلكم الي الكعبين وان كنتم جنب ا فاطهروا وان كنتم مرضي او علي سفر او جاء احد منكم من الغايط او لمستم النساء فلم تجدوا ماء فتيمموا صعيد ا طيب ا فامسحوا بوجوهكم وايديكم منه ما يريد الله ليجعل عليكم من حرج ولكن يريد ليطهركم وليتم نعمتهۥ عليكم لعلكم تشكرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: O ye who believe! When ye rise up for prayer, wash you faces, and your hands up to the elbows, and lightly rub your heads and (wash) your feet up to the ankles. And if ye are unclean, purify yourselves. And if ye are sick or on a journey, or one of you cometh from the closet, or ye have had contact with women, and ye find not water, then go to clean, high ground and rub your faces and your hands with some of it. Allah would not place a burden on you, but He would purify you and would perfect His grace upon you, that ye may give thanks

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذكروا نعمه الله عليكم وميثقه الذي واثقكم بهۦ اذ قلتم سمعنا واطعنا واتقوا الله ان الله عليم بذات الصدور
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Remember Allah's grace upon you and His covenant by which He bound you when ye said: We hear and we obey; And keep your duty to Allah. Lo! He knoweth what is in the breasts (of men)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يايها الذين ءامنوا كونوا قومين لله شهداء بالقسط ولا يجرمنكم شنان قوم علي الا تعدلوا اعدلوا هو اقرب للتقوي واتقوا الله ان الله خبير بما تعملون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: O ye who believe! Be steadfast witnesses for Allah in equity, and let not hatred of any people seduce you that ye deal not justly. Deal justly, that is nearer to your duty. Observe your duty to Allah. Lo! Allah is Informed of what ye do

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وعد الله الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت لهم مغفره واجر عظيم‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Allah hath promised those who believe and do good works: Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا اوليك اصحب الجحيم
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And they who disbelieve and deny Our revelations, such are rightful owners of hell

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الحمد لله الذي خلق السموت والارض وجعل الظلمت والنور ثم الذين كفروا بربهم يعدلون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Praise be to Allah, Who hath created the heavens and the earth, and hath appointed darkness and light. Yet those who disbelieve ascribe rivals unto their Lord

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: هو الذي خلقكم من طين ثم قضي اجل ا واجل مسمي عندهۥ ثم انتم تمترون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He it is Who hath created you from clay, and hath decreed a term for you. A term is fixed with Him. Yet still ye doubt

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وهو الله في السموت وفي الارض يعلم سركم وجهركم ويعلم ما تكسبون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He is Allah in the heavens and in the earth. He knoweth both your secret and your utterance, and He knoweth what ye earn

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما تاتيهم من ءايه من ءايت ربهم الا كانوا عنها معرضين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Never came there unto them a revelation of the revelations of Allah but they did turn away from it

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فقد كذبوا بالحق لما جاءهم فسوف ياتيهم انبوا ما كانوا بهۦ يستهزءون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And they denied the truth when it came unto them. But there will come unto them the tidings of that which they used to deride

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الم يروا كم اهلكنا من قبلهم من قرن مكنهم في الارض ما لم نمكن لكم وارسلنا السماء عليهم مدرار ا وجعلنا الانهر تجري من تحتهم فاهلكنهم بذنوبهم وانشانا من بعدهم قرنا ءاخرين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: See they not how many a generation We destroyed before them, whom We had established in the earth more firmly than We have established you, and We shed on them abundant showers from the sky, and made the rivers flow beneath them. Yet we destroyed them for their sins, and created after them another generation

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولو نزلنا عليك كتب ا في قرطاس فلمسوه بايديهم لقال الذين كفروا ان هذا الا سحر مبين‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Had we sent down unto thee (Muhammad) (actual) writing upon parchment, so that they could feel it with their hands, those who disbelieve would have said: This is naught else than mere magic

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وقالوا لولا انزل عليه ملك ولو انزلنا ملك ا لقضي الامر ثم لا ينظرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They say: Why hath not an angel been sent down unto him? If We sent down an angel, then the matter would be judged; no further time would be allowed them (for reflection)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولو جعلنه ملك ا لجعلنه رجل ا وللبسنا عليهم ما يلبسون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Had we appointed him (Our messenger) an angel, We assuredly had made him (as) a man (that he might speak to men); and (thus) obscured for them (the truth) they (now) obscure

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولقد استهزي برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا بهۦ يستهزءون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Messengers (of Allah) have been derided before thee, but that whereat they scoffed surrounded such of them as did deride

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قل سيروا في الارض ثم انظروا كيف كان عقبه المكذبين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Say (unto the disbelievers): Travel in the land, and see the nature of the consequence for the rejecters

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قل لمن ما في السموت والارض قل لله كتب علي نفسه الرحمه ليجمعنكم الي يوم القيمه لا ريب فيه الذين خسروا انفسهم فهم لا يومنون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Say: Unto whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and the earth? Say: Unto Allah. He hath prescribed for Himself mercy, that He may bring you all together to the Day of Resurrection whereof there is no doubt. Those who ruin their souls will not believe
