initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يايها الناس اتقوا ربكم الذي خلقكم من نفس وحده وخلق منها زوجها وبث منهما رجال ا كثير ا ونساء واتقوا الله الذي تساءلون بهۦ والارحام ان الله كان عليكم رقيب ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: O mankind! Be careful of your duty to your Lord Who created you from a single soul and from it created its mate and from them twain hath spread abroad a multitude of men and women. Be careful of your duty toward Allah in Whom ye claim (your rights) of one another, and toward the wombs (that bare you). Lo! Allah hath been a watcher over you

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وءاتوا اليتمي امولهم ولا تتبدلوا الخبيث بالطيب ولا تاكلوا امولهم الي امولكم انهۥ كان حوب ا كبير ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Give unto orphans their wealth. Exchange not the good for the bad (in your management thereof) nor absorb their wealth into your own wealth. Lo! that would be a great sin

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وان خفتم الا تقسطوا في اليتمي فانكحوا ما طاب لكم من النساء مثني وثلث وربع فان خفتم الا تعدلوا فوحده او ما ملكت ايمنكم ذلك ادني الا تعولوا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And if ye fear that ye will not deal fairly by the orphans, marry of the women, who seem good to you, two or three or four; and if ye fear that ye cannot do justice (to so many) then one (only) or (the captives) that your right hands possess. Thus it is more likely that ye will not do injustice

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وءاتوا النساء صدقتهن نحله فان طبن لكم عن شيء منه نفس ا فكلوه هني ا مري ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And give unto the women (whom ye marry) free gift of their marriage portions; but if they of their own accord remit unto you a part thereof, then ye are welcome to absorb it (in your wealth)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولا توتوا السفهاء امولكم التي جعل الله لكم قيم ا وارزقوهم فيها واكسوهم وقولوا لهم قول ا معروف ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Give not unto the foolish (what is in) your (keeping of their) wealth, which Allah hath given you to maintain; but feed and clothe them from it, and speak kindly unto them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وابتلوا اليتمي حتي اذا بلغوا النكاح فان ءانستم منهم رشد ا فادفعوا اليهم امولهم ولا تاكلوها اسراف ا وبدارا ان يكبروا ومن كان غني ا فليستعفف ومن كان فقير ا فلياكل بالمعروف فاذا دفعتم اليهم امولهم فاشهدوا عليهم وكفي بالله حسيب ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Prove orphans till they reach the marriageable age; then, if ye find them of sound judgment, deliver over unto them their fortune; and devour it not by squandering and in haste lest they should grow up Whoso (of the guardians) is rich, let him abstain generously (from taking of the property of orphans); and whoso is poor let him take thereof in reason (for his guardianship). And when ye deliver up their fortune unto orphans, have (the transaction) witnessed in their presence. Allah sufficeth as a Reckoner

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: للرجال نصيب مما ترك الولدان والاقربون وللنساء نصيب مما ترك الولدان والاقربون مما قل منه او كثر نصيب ا مفروض ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Unto the men (of a family) belongeth a share of that which parents and near kindred leave, and unto the women a share of that which parents and near kindred leave, whether it be little or much - a legal share

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذا حضر القسمه اولوا القربي واليتمي والمسكين فارزقوهم منه وقولوا لهم قول ا معروف ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when kinsfolk and orphans and the needy are present at the division (of the heritage), bestow on them therefrom and speak kindly unto them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وليخش الذين لو تركوا من خلفهم ذريه ضعفا خافوا عليهم فليتقوا الله وليقولوا قول ا سديدا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And let those fear (in their behaviour toward orphans) who if they left behind them weak offspring would be afraid for them. So let them mind their duty to Allah, and speak justly

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان الذين ياكلون امول اليتمي ظلما انما ياكلون في بطونهم نار ا وسيصلون سعير ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! Those who devour the wealth of orphans wrongfully, they do but swallow fire into their bellies, and they will be exposed to burning flame

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يوصيكم الله في اولدكم للذكر مثل حظ الانثيين فان كن نساء فوق اثنتين فلهن ثلثا ما ترك وان كانت وحده فلها النصف ولابويه لكل وحد منهما السدس مما ترك ان كان لهۥ ولد فان لم يكن لهۥ ولد وورثهۥ ابواه فلامه الثلث فان كان لهۥ اخوه فلامه السدس من بعد وصيه يوصي بها او دين ءاباوكم وابناوكم لا تدرون ايهم اقرب لكم نفع ا فريضه من الله ان الله كان عليما حكيم ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Allah chargeth you concerning (the provision for) your children: to the male the equivalent of the portion of two females, and if there be women more than two, then theirs is two-thirds of the inheritance, and if there be one (only) then the half. And to each of his parents a sixth of the inheritance, if he have a son; and if he have no son and his parents are his heirs, then to his mother appertaineth the third; and if he have brethren, then to his mother appertaineth the sixth, after any legacy he may have bequeathed, or debt (hath been paid). Your parents and your children: Ye know not which of them is nearer unto you in usefulness. It is an injunction from Allah. Lo! Allah is Knower, Wise

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ۞ولكم نصف ما ترك ازوجكم ان لم يكن لهن ولد فان كان لهن ولد فلكم الربع مما تركن من بعد وصيه يوصين بها او دين ولهن الربع مما تركتم ان لم يكن لكم ولد فان كان لكم ولد فلهن الثمن مما تركتم من بعد وصيه توصون بها او دين وان كان رجل يورث كلله او امراه ولهۥ اخ او اخت فلكل وحد منهما السدس فان كانوا اكثر من ذلك فهم شركاء في الثلث من بعد وصيه يوصي بها او دين غير مضار وصيه من الله والله عليم حليم‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And unto you belongeth a half of that which your wives leave, if they have no child; but if they have a child then unto you the fourth of that which they leave, after any legacy they may have bequeathed, or debt (they may have contracted, hath been paid). And unto them belongeth the fourth of that which ye leave if ye have no child, but if ye have a child then the eighth of that which ye leave, after any legacy ye may have bequeathed, or debt (ye may have contracted, hath been paid). And if a man or a woman have a distant heir (having left neither parent nor child), and he (or she) have a brother or a sister (only on the mother's side) then to each of them twain (the brother and the sister) the sixth, and if they be more than two, then they shall be sharers in the third, after any legacy that may have been bequeathed or debt (contracted) not injuring (the heirs by willing away more than a third of the heritage) hath been paid. A commandment from Allah. Allah is Knower, Indulgent

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: تلك حدود الله ومن يطع الله ورسولهۥ يدخله جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها وذلك الفوز العظيم
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: These are the limits (imposed by) Allah. Whoso obeyeth Allah and His messenger, He will make him enter Gardens underneath which rivers flow, where such will dwell for ever. That will be the great success

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ومن يعص الله ورسولهۥ ويتعد حدودهۥ يدخله نارا خلد ا فيها ولهۥ عذاب مهين‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And whoso disobeyeth Allah and His messenger and transgresseth His limits, He will make him enter Fire, where he will dwell for ever; his will be a shameful doom

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: والتي ياتين الفحشه من نسايكم فاستشهدوا عليهن اربعه منكم فان شهدوا فامسكوهن في البيوت حتي يتوفيهن الموت او يجعل الله لهن سبيل ا
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: As for those of your women who are guilty of lewdness, call to witness four of you against them. And if they testify (to the truth of the allegation) then confine them to the houses until death take them or (until) Allah appoint for them a way (through new legislation)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: كتب انزل اليك فلا يكن في صدرك حرج منه لتنذر بهۦ وذكري للمومنين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: (It is) a Scripture that is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) - so let there be no heaviness in thy heart therefrom - that thou mayst warn thereby, and (it is) a Reminder unto believers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اتبعوا ما انزل اليكم من ربكم ولا تتبعوا من دونهۦ اولياء قليل ا ما تذكرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: (Saying): Follow that which is sent down unto you from your Lord, and follow no protecting friends beside Him. Little do ye recollect

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وكم من قريه اهلكنها فجاءها باسنا بيتا او هم قايلون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: How many a township have We destroyed! As a raid by night, or while they slept at noon, Our terror came unto them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فما كان دعويهم اذ جاءهم باسنا الا ان قالوا انا كنا ظلمين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: No plea had they, when Our terror came unto them, save that they said: Lo! We were wrong-doers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فلنسلن الذين ارسل اليهم ولنسلن المرسلين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Then verily We shall question those unto whom (Our message) hath been sent, and verily We shall question the messengers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فلنقصن عليهم بعلم وما كنا غايبين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Then verily We shall narrate unto them (the event) with knowledge, for We were not absent (when it came to pass)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: والوزن يوميذ الحق فمن ثقلت موزينهۥ فاوليك هم المفلحون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: The weighing on that day is the true (weighing). As for those whose scale is heavy, they are the successful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ومن خفت موزينهۥ فاوليك الذين خسروا انفسهم بما كانوا بايتنا يظلمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And as for those whose scale is light: those are they who lose their souls because they used to wrong Our revelations

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولقد مكنكم في الارض وجعلنا لكم فيها معيش قليل ا ما تشكرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And We have given you (mankind) power in the earth, and appointed for you therein livelihoods. Little give ye thanks

initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Allah! There is no god save Him, the Alive, the Eternal

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: نزل عليك الكتب بالحق مصدق ا لما بين يديه وانزل التوريه والانجيل
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture with truth, confirming that which was (revealed) before it, even as He revealed the Torah and the Gospel

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: من قبل هد ي للناس وانزل الفرقان ان الذين كفروا بايت الله لهم عذاب شديد والله عزيز ذو انتقام
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Aforetime, for a guidance to mankind; and hath revealed the Criterion (of right and wrong). Lo! those who disbelieve the revelations of Allah, theirs will be a heavy doom. Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان الله لا يخفي عليه شيء في الارض ولا في السماء
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! nothing in the earth or in the heavens is hidden from Allah

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: هو الذي يصوركم في الارحام كيف يشاء لا اله الا هو العزيز الحكيم
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He it is Who fashioneth you in the wombs as pleaseth Him. There is no Allah save Him, the Almighty, the Wise

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: هو الذي انزل عليك الكتب منه ءايت محكمت هن ام الكتب واخر متشبهت فاما الذين في قلوبهم زيغ فيتبعون ما تشبه منه ابتغاء الفتنه وابتغاء تاويلهۦ وما يعلم تاويلهۥ الا الله والرسخون في العلم يقولون ءامنا بهۦ كل من عند ربنا وما يذكر الا اولوا الالبب
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He it is Who hath revealed unto thee (Muhammad) the Scripture wherein are clear revelations - they are the substance of the Book - and others (which are) allegorical. But those in whose hearts is doubt pursue, forsooth, that which is allegorical seeking (to cause) dissension by seeking to explain it. None knoweth its explanation save Allah. And those who are of sound instruction say: We believe therein; the whole is from our Lord; but only men of understanding really heed

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ربنا لا تزغ قلوبنا بعد اذ هديتنا وهب لنا من لدنك رحمه انك انت الوهاب
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Our Lord! Cause not our hearts to stray after Thou hast guided us, and bestow upon us mercy from Thy Presence. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Bestower

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ربنا انك جامع الناس ليوم لا ريب فيه ان الله لا يخلف الميعاد
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! it is Thou Who gatherest mankind together to a Day of which there is no doubt. Lo! Allah faileth not to keep the tryst

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ان الذين كفروا لن تغني عنهم امولهم ولا اولدهم من الله شي ا واوليك هم وقود النار
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: (On that Day) neither the riches nor the progeny of those who disbelieve will aught avail them with Allah. They will be fuel for Fire

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: كداب ءال فرعون والذين من قبلهم كذبوا بايتنا فاخذهم الله بذنوبهم والله شديد العقاب
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Like Pharaoh's folk and those who were before them, they disbelieved Our revelations and so Allah seized them for their sins. And Allah is severe in punishment

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قل للذين كفروا ستغلبون وتحشرون الي جهنم وبيس المهاد
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Say (O Muhammad) unto those who disbelieve: Ye shall be overcome and gathered unto Hell, an evil resting-place

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قد كان لكم ءايه في فيتين التقتا فيه تقتل في سبيل الله واخري كافره يرونهم مثليهم راي العين والله يويد بنصرهۦ من يشاء ان في ذلك لعبره لاولي الابصر
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: There was a token for you in two hosts which met: one army fighting in the way of Allah, and another disbelieving, whom they saw as twice their number, clearly, with their very eyes. Thus Allah strengtheneth with His succour whom He will. Lo! herein verily is a lesson for those who have eyes

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: زين للناس حب الشهوت من النساء والبنين والقنطير المقنطره من الذهب والفضه والخيل المسومه والانعم والحرث ذلك متع الحيوه الدنيا والله عندهۥ حسن الماب
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Beautified for mankind is love of the joys (that come) from women and offspring; and stored-up heaps of gold and silver, and horses branded (with their mark), and cattle and land. That is comfort of the life of the world. Allah! With Him is a more excellent abode

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ۞قل اونبيكم بخير من ذلكم للذين اتقوا عند ربهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر خلدين فيها وازوج مطهره ورضون من الله والله بصير بالعباد
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Say: Shall I inform you of something better than that? For those who keep from evil, with their Lord, are Gardens underneath which rivers flow wherein they will abide, and pure companions, and contentment from Allah. Allah is Seer of His bondmen

initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ما ياتيهم من ذكر من ربهم محدث الا استمعوه وهم يلعبون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لاهيه قلوبهم واسروا النجوي الذين ظلموا هل هذا الا بشر مثلكم افتاتون السحر وانتم تبصرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: With hearts preoccupied. And they confer in secret. The wrong-doers say: Is this other than a mortal like you? Will ye then succumb to magic when ye see (it)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قال ربي يعلم القول في السماء والارض وهو السميع العليم
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He saith: My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth. He is the Hearer, the Knower

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: بل قالوا اضغث احلم بل افتريه بل هو شاعر فلياتنا بايه كما ارسل الاولون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Nay, say they, (these are but) muddled dreams; nay, he hath but invented it; nay, he is but a poet. Let him bring us a portent even as those of old (who were Allah's messengers) were sent (with portents)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ما ءامنت قبلهم من قريه اهلكنها افهم يومنون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Not a township believed of those which We destroyed before them (though We sent them portents): would they then believe

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما ارسلنا قبلك الا رجال ا نوحي اليهم فسلوا اهل الذكر ان كنتم لا تعلمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And We sent not (as Our messengers) before thee other than men, whom We inspired. Ask the followers of the Reminder if ye know not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما جعلنهم جسد ا لا ياكلون الطعام وما كانوا خلدين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: We gave them not bodies that would not eat food, nor were they immortals

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ثم صدقنهم الوعد فانجينهم ومن نشاء واهلكنا المسرفين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Then we fulfilled the promise unto them. So we delivered them and whom We would, and We destroyed the prodigals

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لقد انزلنا اليكم كتب ا فيه ذكركم افلا تعقلون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Now We have revealed unto you a Scripture wherein is your Reminder. Have ye then no sense

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وكم قصمنا من قريه كانت ظالمه وانشانا بعدها قوما ءاخرين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: How many a community that dealt unjustly have We shattered, and raised up after them another folk

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فلما احسوا باسنا اذا هم منها يركضون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And, when they felt Our might, behold them fleeing from it

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لا تركضوا وارجعوا الي ما اترفتم فيه ومسكنكم لعلكم تسلون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: (But it was said unto them): Flee not, but return to that (existence) which emasculated you and to your dwellings, that ye may be questioned

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قالوا يويلنا انا كنا ظلمين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They cried: Alas for us! we were wrong-doers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فما زالت تلك دعويهم حتي جعلنهم حصيدا خمدين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And this their crying ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما خلقنا السماء والارض وما بينهما لعبين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them in play

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لو اردنا ان نتخذ لهو ا لاتخذنه من لدنا ان كنا فعلين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: If We had wished to find a pastime, We could have found it in Our presence - if We ever did

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: بل نقذف بالحق علي البطل فيدمغهۥ فاذا هو زاهق ولكم الويل مما تصفون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولهۥ من في السموت والارض ومن عندهۥ لا يستكبرون عن عبادتهۦ ولا يستحسرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those who dwell in His presence are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they weary

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يسبحون اليل والنهار لا يفترون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They glorify (Him) night and day; they flag not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ام اتخذوا ءالهه من الارض هم ينشرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Or have they chosen gods from the earth who raise the dead

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لو كان فيهما ءالهه الا الله لفسدتا فسبحن الله رب العرش عما يصفون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: If there were therein gods beside Allah, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) had been disordered. Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لا يسل عما يفعل وهم يسلون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ام اتخذوا من دونهۦ ءالهه قل هاتوا برهنكم هذا ذكر من معي وذكر من قبلي بل اكثرهم لا يعلمون الحق فهم معرضون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Or have they chosen other gods beside Him? say: Bring your proof (of their godhead). This is the Reminder of those with me and those before me, but most of them know not the Truth and so they are averse

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما ارسلنا من قبلك من رسول الا نوحي اليه انهۥ لا اله الا انا فاعبدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And We sent no messenger before thee but We inspired him, (saying): There is no Allah save Me (Allah), so worship Me

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وقالوا اتخذ الرحمن ولد ا سبحنهۥ بل عباد مكرمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And they say: The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a son. Be He Glorified! Nay, but (those whom they call sons) are honoured slaves

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لا يسبقونهۥ بالقول وهم بامرهۦ يعملون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يعلم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم ولا يشفعون الا لمن ارتضي وهم من خشيتهۦ مشفقون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ۞ومن يقل منهم اني اله من دونهۦ فذلك نجزيه جهنم كذلك نجزي الظلمين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And one of them who should say: Lo! I am a god beside Him, that one We should repay with hell. Thus We Repay wrong-doers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اولم ير الذين كفروا ان السموت والارض كانتا رتق ا ففتقنهما وجعلنا من الماء كل شيء حي افلا يومنون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece, then We parted them, and we made every living thing of water? Will they not then believe

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وجعلنا في الارض روسي ان تميد بهم وجعلنا فيها فجاج ا سبل ا لعلهم يهتدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And We have placed in the earth firm hills lest it quake with them, and We have placed therein ravines as roads that haply they may find their way

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وجعلنا السماء سقف ا محفوظ ا وهم عن ءايتها معرضون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And we have made the sky a roof withheld (from them). Yet they turn away from its portents

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وهو الذي خلق اليل والنهار والشمس والقمر كل في فلك يسبحون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما جعلنا لبشر من قبلك الخلد افاين مت فهم الخلدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: We appointed immortality for no mortal before thee. What! if thou diest, can they be immortal

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: كل نفس ذايقه الموت ونبلوكم بالشر والخير فتنه والينا ترجعون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Every soul must taste of death, and We try you with evil and with good, for ordeal. And unto Us ye will be returned

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذا رءاك الذين كفروا ان يتخذونك الا هزوا اهذا الذي يذكر ءالهتكم وهم بذكر الرحمن هم كفرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when those who disbelieve behold thee, they but choose thee out for mockery, (saying): Is this he who maketh mention of your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: خلق الانسن من عجل ساوريكم ءايتي فلا تستعجلون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Man is made of haste. I shall show you My portents, but ask Me not to hasten

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ويقولون متي هذا الوعد ان كنتم صدقين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And they say: When will this promise (be fulfilled), if ye are truthful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: لو يعلم الذين كفروا حين لا يكفون عن وجوههم النار ولا عن ظهورهم ولا هم ينصرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off the fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: بل تاتيهم بغته فتبهتهم فلا يستطيعون ردها ولا هم ينظرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولقد استهزي برسل من قبلك فحاق بالذين سخروا منهم ما كانوا بهۦ يستهزءون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked, but that whereat they mocked surrounded those who scoffed at them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قل من يكلوكم باليل والنهار من الرحمن بل هم عن ذكر ربهم معرضون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ام لهم ءالهه تمنعهم من دوننا لا يستطيعون نصر انفسهم ولا هم منا يصحبون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Or have they gods who can shield them from Us? They cannot help themselves nor can they be defended from Us

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: بل متعنا هولاء وءاباءهم حتي طال عليهم العمر افلا يرون انا ناتي الارض ننقصها من اطرافها افهم الغلبون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Nay, but We gave these and their fathers ease until life grew long for them. See they not how we aim to the land, reducing it of its outlying parts? Can they then be the victors

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قل انما انذركم بالوحي ولا يسمع الصم الدعاء اذا ما ينذرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I warn you only by the Inspiration. But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولين مستهم نفحه من عذاب ربك ليقولن يويلنا انا كنا ظلمين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ونضع الموزين القسط ليوم القيمه فلا تظلم نفس شي ا وان كان مثقال حبه من خردل اتينا بها وكفي بنا حسبين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ولقد ءاتينا موسي وهرون الفرقان وضياء وذكر ا للمتقين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion (of right and wrong) and a light and a Reminder for those who keep from evil

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الذين يخشون ربهم بالغيب وهم من الساعه مشفقون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Those who fear their Lord in secret and who dread the Hour (of doom)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وهذا ذكر مبارك انزلنه افانتم لهۥ منكرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: This is a blessed Reminder that we have revealed: Will ye then reject it

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يايها الناس اعبدوا ربكم الذي خلقكم والذين من قبلكم لعلكم تتقون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: O mankind! worship your Lord, Who hath created you and those before you, so that ye may ward off (evil)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الذي جعل لكم الارض فرش ا والسماء بناء وانزل من السماء ماء فاخرج بهۦ من الثمرت رزق ا لكم فلا تجعلوا لله انداد ا وانتم تعلمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وان كنتم في ريب مما نزلنا علي عبدنا فاتوا بسوره من مثلهۦ وادعوا شهداءكم من دون الله ان كنتم صدقين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And if ye are in doubt concerning that which We reveal unto Our slave (Muhammad), then produce a surah of the like thereof, and call your witness beside Allah if ye are truthful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فان لم تفعلوا ولن تفعلوا فاتقوا النار التي وقودها الناس والحجاره اعدت للكفرين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And if ye do it not - and ye can never do it - then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وبشر الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصلحت ان لهم جنت تجري من تحتها الانهر كلما رزقوا منها من ثمره رزق ا قالوا هذا الذي رزقنا من قبل واتوا بهۦ متشبه ا ولهم فيها ازوج مطهره وهم فيها خلدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And give glad tidings (O Muhammad) unto those who believe and do good works; that theirs are Gardens underneath which rivers flow; as often as they are regaled with food of the fruit thereof, they say: this is what was given us aforetime; and it is given to them in resemblance. There for them are pure companions; there for ever they abide

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ۞ان الله لا يستحيۦ ان يضرب مثل ا ما بعوضه فما فوقها فاما الذين ءامنوا فيعلمون انه الحق من ربهم واما الذين كفروا فيقولون ماذا اراد الله بهذا مثل ا يضل بهۦ كثير ا ويهدي بهۦ كثير ا وما يضل بهۦ الا الفسقين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Lo! Allah disdaineth not to coin the similitude even of a gnat. Those who believe know that it is the truth from their Lord; but those who disbelieve say: What doth Allah wish (to teach) by such a similitude? He misleadeth many thereby, and He guideth many thereby; and He misleadeth thereby only miscreants

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الذين ينقضون عهد الله من بعد ميثقهۦ ويقطعون ما امر الله بهۦ ان يوصل ويفسدون في الارض اوليك هم الخسرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Those who break the covenant of Allah after ratifying it, and sever that which Allah ordered to be joined, and (who) make mischief in the earth: Those are they who are the losers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: كيف تكفرون بالله وكنتم اموت ا فاحيكم ثم يميتكم ثم يحييكم ثم اليه ترجعون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: How disbelieve ye in Allah when ye were dead and He gave life to you! Then He will give you death, then life again, and then unto Him ye will return

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: هو الذي خلق لكم ما في الارض جميع ا ثم استوي الي السماء فسويهن سبع سموت وهو بكل شيء عليم‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He it is Who created for you all that is in the earth. Then turned He to the heaven, and fashioned it as seven heavens. And He is knower of all things

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذ قال ربك للمليكه اني جاعل في الارض خليفه قالوا اتجعل فيها من يفسد فيها ويسفك الدماء ونحن نسبح بحمدك ونقدس لك قال اني اعلم ما لا تعلمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when thy Lord said unto the angels: Lo! I am about to place a viceroy in the earth, they said: Wilt thou place therein one who will do harm therein and will shed blood, while we, we hymn Thy praise and sanctify Thee? He said: Surely I know that which ye know not

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وعلم ءادم الاسماء كلها ثم عرضهم علي المليكه فقال انبوني باسماء هولاء ان كنتم صدقين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And He taught Adam all the names, then showed them to the angels, saying: Inform Me of the names of these, if ye are truthful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قالوا سبحنك لا علم لنا الا ما علمتنا انك انت العليم الحكيم
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They said: Be glorified! We have no knowledge saving that which Thou hast taught us. Lo! Thou, only Thou, art the Knower, the Wise

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قال يادم انبيهم باسمايهم فلما انباهم باسمايهم قال الم اقل لكم اني اعلم غيب السموت والارض واعلم ما تبدون وما كنتم تكتمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: He said: O Adam! Inform them of their names, and when he had informed them of their names, He said: Did I not tell you that I know the secret of the heavens and the earth? And I know that which ye disclose and which ye hide

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذ قلنا للمليكه اسجدوا لادم فسجدوا الا ابليس ابي واستكبر وكان من الكفرين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when We said unto the angels: Prostrate yourselves before Adam, they fell prostrate, all save Iblis. He demurred through pride, and so became a disbeliever

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وقلنا يادم اسكن انت وزوجك الجنه وكلا منها رغدا حيث شيتما ولا تقربا هذه الشجره فتكونا من الظلمين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And We said: O Adam! Dwell thou and thy wife in the Garden, and eat ye freely (of the fruits) thereof where ye will; but come not nigh this tree lest ye become wrong-doers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فازلهما الشيطن عنها فاخرجهما مما كانا فيه وقلنا اهبطوا بعضكم لبعض عدو ولكم في الارض مستقر ومتع الي حين‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: But Satan caused them to deflect therefrom and expelled them from the (happy) state in which they were; and We said: Fall down, one of you a foe unto the other! There shall be for you on earth a habitation and provision for a time

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: فتلقي ءادم من ربهۦ كلمت فتاب عليه انهۥ هو التواب الرحيم
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Then Adam received from his Lord words (of revelation), and He relented toward him. Lo! He is the relenting, the Merciful

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: قلنا اهبطوا منها جميع ا فاما ياتينكم مني هد ي فمن تبع هداي فلا خوف عليهم ولا هم يحزنون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: We said: Go down, all of you, from hence; but verily there cometh unto you from Me a guidance; and whoso followeth My guidance, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: والذين كفروا وكذبوا بايتنا اوليك اصحب النار هم فيها خلدون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: But they who disbelieve, and deny Our revelations, such are rightful Peoples of the Fire. They will abide therein

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يبني اسرءيل اذكروا نعمتي التي انعمت عليكم واوفوا بعهدي اوف بعهدكم وايي فارهبون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: O Children of Israel! Remember My favour wherewith I favoured you, and fulfil your (part of the) covenant, I shall fulfil My (part of the) covenant, and fear Me

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يسلونك عن الانفال قل الانفال لله والرسول فاتقوا الله واصلحوا ذات بينكم واطيعوا الله ورسولهۥ ان كنتم مومنين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They ask thee (O Muhammad) of the spoils of war. Say: The spoils of war belong to Allah and the messenger, so keep your duty to Allah, and adjust the matter of your difference, and obey Allah and His messenger, if ye are (true) believers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: انما المومنون الذين اذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم واذا تليت عليهم ءايتهۥ زادتهم ايمن ا وعلي ربهم يتوكلون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: They only are the (true) believers whose hearts feel fear when Allah is mentioned, and when His revelations are recited unto them they increase their faith, and who trust in their Lord

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: الذين يقيمون الصلوه ومما رزقنهم ينفقون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Who establish worship and spend of that We have bestowed on them

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اوليك هم المومنون حق ا لهم درجت عند ربهم ومغفره ورزق كريم‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Those are they who are in truth believers. For them are grades (of honour) with their Lord, and pardon, and a bountiful provision

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: كما اخرجك ربك من بيتك بالحق وان فريق ا من المومنين لكرهون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Even as thy Lord caused thee (Muhammad) to go forth from thy home with the Truth, and lo! a party of the believers were averse (to it)

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: يجدلونك في الحق بعد ما تبين كانما يساقون الي الموت وهم ينظرون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Disputing with thee of the Truth after it had been made manifest, as if they were being driven to death visible

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: واذ يعدكم الله احدي الطايفتين انها لكم وتودون ان غير ذات الشوكه تكون لكم ويريد الله ان يحق الحق بكلمتهۦ ويقطع دابر الكفرين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: And when Allah promised you one of the two bands (of the enemy) that it should be yours, and ye longed that other than the armed one might be yours. And Allah willed that He should cause the Truth to triumph by His words, and cut the root of the disbelievers

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: ليحق الحق ويبطل البطل ولو كره المجرمون
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: That He might cause the Truth to triumph and bring vanity to naught, however much the guilty might oppose

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اذ تستغيثون ربكم فاستجاب لكم اني ممدكم بالف من المليكه مردفين
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: When ye sought help of your Lord and He answered you (saying): I will help you with a thousand of the angels, rank on rank

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: وما جعله الله الا بشري ولتطمين بهۦ قلوبكم وما النصر الا من عند الله ان الله عزيز حكيم
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: Allah appointed it only as good tidings, and that your hearts thereby might be at rest. Victory cometh only by the help of Allah. Lo! Allah is Mighty, Wise

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اذ يغشيكم النعاس امنه منه وينزل عليكم من السماء ماء ليطهركم بهۦ ويذهب عنكم رجز الشيطن وليربط علي قلوبكم ويثبت به الاقدام
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: When He made the slumber fall upon you as a reassurance from him and sent down water from the sky upon you, that thereby He might purify you, and remove from you the fear of Satan, and make strong your hearts and firm (your) feet thereby

initial_ayahs.arabic_witness_label: Standard rasm for verses on this leaf (not a traced facsimile of the scribe)
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard: اذ يوحي ربك الي المليكه اني معكم فثبتوا الذين ءامنوا سالقي في قلوب الذين كفروا الرعب فاضربوا فوق الاعناق واضربوا منهم كل بنان‏
initial_ayahs.arabic_standard_label: Uthmani rasm (Tanzil / King Fahd complex, diacritics stripped for comparison)
initial_ayahs.english_pickthall: When thy Lord inspired the angels, (saying): I am with you. So make those who believe stand firm. I will throw fear into the hearts of those who disbelieve. Then smite the necks and smite of them each finger
